author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
What happens when someone really really wants to play skyrim but their parents dont allow it? Compromise. And the compromise achieved in this legendary story from reddit allowed us to create the most insane style of skyrim challenge the world has ever seen. The Zack's Parents Skyrim Challenge otherwise known as Skyrim Challenge From God. A Run of skyrim that requires, no magic, no enchanting, no potions, no overpowered daedric artifacts, no shouts, no vampires, no werewolves, no stealing, no looting the dead. Its the most morally pure run at an attempt of skyrim I have ever seen. 

Want to look spiffing? Try https://spiffing.store/
